The database ports on the VM are never open.<br><br>Langfuse web and worker both use PostgreSQL and the three stores. div.div:
Changed from the plan: one PostgreSQL 17 instance holds both databases (plan: 18 for the monitor, a separate 17 for Langfuse).
How it grows
Sprint 1: front door, backend, Collector (file output), Cloud SQL.
Sprint 2: Langfuse and its three stores on the VM (Redis, ClickHouse, MinIO), the dashboard.
Sprint 3: OAuth2 Proxy and Langfuse SSO.
Firewall (ingress)
443 from the job network ranges. 8443 and 3443 from the staff ranges. 22 from IAP only. The database ports on the VM are never open.
Langfuse web and worker both use PostgreSQL and the three stores. The Sprint 3 Kubernetes test runs on the test AWS cluster, not here.
